_comment: Cluster topology. Copy to /opt/tinyfaas/nodes.json on the controller
The leader is dispatch_only: it schedules and powers nodes but never
runs a function itself. That matches the design in the expose, keeps
its power draw a constant rather than something that varies with load,
and means the first request wakes a worker instead of being absorbed
Node ids match the SSH aliases and physical labels (pi1..pi4). The
energy logger uses the same ids:
channel is the channel ON THAT RELAY (0 or 1), not a cluster-wide index.
